expected_structural_delta: No new production module or service in Creator; one small FAT settings document shared with the OS initializer; focused integration coverage.
minimum_design: Reuse compressed raw writer and GPT FAT access; write and verify a small setup document on partition 2.
outcome: Write preinstalled compressed ZFS USB images and hand setup settings to Unraid without host ZFS support.

reuse_decisions.name: raw image writer and GPT FAT wrapper
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing verified compression and block writer; only the Unraid settings destination differs.
